name: tools.klaro/jobs
title: Klaro Doctor Jobs Germany
description: Search doctor and hospital jobs in Germany by specialty, city and level, incl. Berufserlaubnis jobs.

tools.name: search_doctor_jobs
tools.description: Search Klaro's open jobs for physicians in German hospitals, practices and MVZ (about 13,000, from the employers' own career pages, re-checked several times a day). Returns up to 20 jobs with title, employer, place, specialty, career level and a link to the Klaro job page, plus the total number of matches. Values are German (e.g. specialty "Innere Medizin", state "Bayern", career_level "Assistenzarzt"). Call list_medical_specialties for the exact spellings. With city and radius_km (1 to 100) it lists only jobs within that distance of the town, nearest first; exclude_employer leaves employers out.

specialty.description: Fachrichtung, e.g. "Innere Medizin", "Anästhesiologie", "Psychiatrie". One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

state.description: Bundesland, e.g. "Berlin", "Nordrhein-Westfalen". One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

career_level.description: Assistenzarzt, Facharzt, Oberarzt, Leitender Oberarzt or Chefarzt. One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

hospital_type.description: e.g. "Uniklinik", "Maximalversorger", "MVZ", "Rehaklinik". One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

employer.description: Employer name exactly as list_medical_specialties returns it. One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

exclude_employer.description: Employers to leave out, spelled as list_medical_specialties returns them. One value, or up to 5 (any of them matches). Spell values as list_medical_specialties returns them.

city.description: Town or postcode, e.g. "Leipzig" or "04103". suggest_job_locations helps with spelling.

radius_km.description: Only jobs at most this many km from city (needs city), nearest first, e.g. 25. The page offers 10, 25, 50 and 100.

text.description: Free text in the job title or advert, e.g. "Notaufnahme" or "Weiterbildung Kardiologie".

contract.description: Vollzeit (full time), Teilzeit (part time), Befristung (fixed term).

posted_within.description: Only jobs posted in the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days.

instant_apply_only.description: Only jobs a doctor can apply to directly through Klaro ("Sofort bewerben").

training_only.description: Only jobs at a hospital with a specialty training authorisation (Weiterbildungsbefugnis) in the job's specialty.

berufserlaubnis_only.description: Only jobs open to doctors who hold a Berufserlaubnis (temporary licence) rather than the full Approbation: the advert says so, or a rural clinic has been hiring for 90+ days and does not ask for the Approbation.

sort.description: relevance (default) or date (newest first). A radius search is always nearest first.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Read one job in full as Markdown (employer, place, contract, tasks, requirements, offer) by the id search_doctor_jobs returned. The employer's original advert stays the binding source.

tools.name: compare_jobs
tools.description: Compare up to 5 doctor jobs side by side: reads each one in full, the same content as get_job_details.

tools.name: list_medical_specialties
tools.description: The medical specialties (Fachrichtungen) and the other values search_doctor_jobs accepts (Bundesländer, career levels, hospital types, largest employers), each with its number of open jobs right now.

tools.name: suggest_job_locations
tools.description: Towns with open doctor jobs that match a few letters or a postcode, with their Bundesland. Use the result as search_doctor_jobs' city.

query.description: Start of a town name or a postcode.

tools.name: get_pay_table
tools.description: The published monthly gross pay for hospital doctors in Germany, step by step, from the tariff's own table: TV-Ärzte/VKA (municipal hospitals), TV-Ärzte TdL (university hospitals), Helios, Asklepios, Sana, Rhön, BG Kliniken and Charité. Each answer names the table's valid-from date, its source document and the day Klaro read it. A tariff Klaro has no checked table for is answered as such, never estimated.

tariff.description: Tariff key or name: vka, tdl, helios, asklepios, sana, rhoen, bg, charite ("TV-Ärzte/VKA", "Uniklinik" and "kommunal" also work).

group.description: Pay group: assistenzarzt (Ä1), facharzt (Ä2) or oberarzt (Ä3). Left out: all three.

year.description: Year in the pay group as the table counts it (1 = first year as Assistenzarzt, Facharzt or Oberarzt), for the pay in that year. Not a calendar year.

tools.name: get_licence_rules
tools.description: For doctors with a foreign degree, per Bundesland: the authority that grants the Approbation and Berufserlaubnis, the fees for the Fachsprachprüfung, Kenntnisprüfung, Approbation and Berufserlaubnis, published waiting and processing times, the Berufserlaubnis rule and whether a job offer is needed for it. Every figure comes from an official page, with its address and Klaro's check date; where the authority publishes nothing the answer says "keine offizielle Angabe". Not legal advice.

state.description: Bundesland, e.g. "Bayern", "Nordrhein-Westfalen" (English names and abbreviations such as "Bavaria" or "NRW" work).

tools.name: get_exam_dates
tools.description: The upcoming Fachsprachprüfung (FSP, medical German) and Kenntnisprüfung (KP) dates a Bundesland's chamber or authority has published, how often exams take place and how a candidate gets a date, each with its official source and the day Klaro read it. Past dates are left out. Where no dates are published the answer says "no dates published".

state.description: Bundesland, e.g. "Hessen" (English names and abbreviations work).

lang.description: Language of the explanations: en (default) or de. Names of German bodies stay German.

tools.name: get_market_numbers
tools.description: The newest figures of Klaro's monthly Arztstellen-Report: open doctor job adverts in Germany, employers, new adverts, shares open to a Berufserlaubnis (the advert says so, or a rural clinic hiring for 90+ days) or naming a tariff, counts by specialty, Bundesland and career level, and the German level adverts ask for. With the report and CSV links and the counting method. Closed months stay unchanged and citable.

month.description: A month as YYYY-MM (e.g. "2026-10"); left out: the newest report.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Klaro's guides for doctors moving to or working in Germany (CV, cover letter, Approbation per state, pay, German level, visa), the Facharzt training pages (each specialty's MWBO training time) and the salary and Approbation-time calculators, in German, English and Arabic. Returns each page's short answer, its link and the day its facts were checked.

query.description: A few words, e.g. "Kenntnisprüfung Kosten Bayern", "Facharzt Kardiologie Dauer", "cover letter".

lang.description: Only pages in this language. Left out: all three.

tools.name: search_hospitation
tools.description: Find German hospitals for a Hospitation (observership: a short visit to watch a hospital's daily work, for doctors trained abroad, for example while waiting for the Approbation, Fachsprachprüfung or Kenntnisprüfung, and for students), a Famulatur (the required clinical placement of German medical studies) or a PJ (Praktisches Jahr, the final clinical year: a PJ-Tertial is possible only at university and teaching hospitals). Use it for questions like "how do I find a PJ placement in Germany", "PJ-Tertial in Germany as a foreign medical student", "Wie finde ich einen PJ-Platz?", "Famulatur in Germany" or "observership in a German hospital". Returns up to 20 hospitals with town, Bundesland, departments, whether it is a teaching hospital, whether it has its own Hospitation/Famulatur/PJ page, and the Klaro page where the user writes the request (needs a Klaro account; none where Klaro has no address yet), plus the free Klaro list and guide and short facts with their official sources (for the PJ: students of German universities book through the PJ-Portal). Filter by specialty (German or English, e.g. "Innere Medizin", "Surgery"), state (Bundesland) and city. Never returns e-mail addresses or names of contact persons; read-only, it sends nothing.

kind.description: hospitation (default; observership, for doctors and students), famulatur (clinical placement, for medical students) or pj (Praktisches Jahr / PJ-Tertial, final-year medical students; university and teaching hospitals only).

specialty.description: Department, in German or English, e.g. "Innere Medizin", "Kardiologie", "Gynäkologie", "Psychiatry". An unknown one is answered with the list.

state.description: Bundesland, e.g. "Bayern" (English names and abbreviations such as "Bavaria" or "NRW" work).

lang.description: Language of the Klaro page links and facts: de (default) or en.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Klaro's doctor jobs in Germany for research clients (returns ids, titles and links; read one with fetch). A specialty, career level or Bundesland named in the query is used as a filter, the other words as free text or a town. Prefer search_doctor_jobs for filtered searches.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Kardiologie Hamburg Oberarzt".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one job by the id search returned, as text with its link.
